title: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skeleton graph attention for autism video analysis weights joints by content alone, giving an erratic wrist the same standing as a still one. Stereotypy, however, is defined by how unpredictably movement unfolds rather than how much of it occurs: in our cohort, every amplitude-based kinematic descriptor falls in stereotyped clips, while windowed Sample Entropy of angular velocity alone rises (Hedges' g = +1.05). We compute this irregularity as a per-joint, per-frame tensor that structurally drives computation. The proposed chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts model (CGM) couples two mechanisms. First, a learned pairwise term added to the graph-attention logit concentrates attention on irregular joints and re-ranks the remaining edge weight toward jointly irregular pairs; its unconstrained coefficient neither vanishes nor inverts, and zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips. translated_title: CGM：用于自闭症刻板行为检测的混沌引导图注意力与专家路由模型
translated_abstract: 用于自闭症视频分析的骨架图注意力方法仅根据内容对关节进行加权，这使得不规律摆动的手腕与静止的手腕获得同等的地位。然而，刻板行为的定义在于运动展开方式的不确定性，而非运动量的大小：在我们的研究队列中，所有基于幅度的运动学描述子在刻板动作片段中均下降，唯独角速度的窗口化样本熵上升（Hedges' g = +1.05）。我们将这种不规律性计算为逐关节、逐帧的张量，并使其从结构上驱动整个计算过程。所提出的混沌引导图注意力与专家混合模型（CGM）结合了两种机制：第一，在图注意力logit中加入一个可学习的成对项，将注意力集中于不规律的关节，并将剩余的边权重重新排序至共同不规律的关节对；其无约束系数既不会消失也不会反转，将该张量置零会使94%的片段中的注意力重新对齐。第二，一个以……为条件的门控机制（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CGM模型，将逐关节、逐帧的运动不规律性（样本熵）张量直接融入图注意力计算和专家路由机制，使模型聚焦于运动不可预测的关节，从而更准确地区分自闭症刻板行为与正常运动。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CGM, which structurally embeds per-joint, per-frame motion irregularity (sample entropy) tensors into graph attention and expert routing, enabling the model to focus on unpredictably moving joints for more accurate detection of autistic stereotypy.
